phases: Phase 1: Decision-record contract -- qor/scripts/adr_contract.py (vocabulary with per-value definitions, record parser, tier-table parser; reads no ledger), doctrine-decision-records.md plus its required README doctrine-inventory row, backfill three records (240 and 241 Implemented, 239 Accepted with its stale ratification clause retired), Tier 2 contract amended in all three carriers, glossary with non-empty referenced_by on both terms, and eight unchanged live consumers named across seven Affected-Files entries

Phase 2: Decision-record conformance detector -- qor/scripts/adr_status_lint.py with two ledger-free finding kinds, a stated docs/ADR_*.md discovery glob and an entry-point guard, registered as a Check in status_json.default_registry, CLI dispatch proven by subprocess, FEATURE_INDEX FX028

limitations: The detector reads decision records only and never opens docs/META_LEDGER.md, so it cannot judge whether a declared status matches reality.
The three backfilled statuses are asserted on evidence recorded in LD-6; they become machine-checked when Phase 259 ships the seal binding.
Registering the new doctrine in the governance index is correct but unverified: governance_index cannot raise unregistered for a file under qor/references/, so no gate confirms the row exists.

Two whole-corpus invariants govern qor/references/doctrine-*.md: a README completeness assertion that turns pytest red without an inventory row, and a terminology assertion forbidding a bare change_type identifier. Both are satisfied by this phase and named in LD-10.
non_goals: Deciding whether a decision record's content is correct.
Any change to how /qor-status behaves without an explicit flag.
exclusions: The seal-binding surface: adr-status-stale, adr-phase-unsealed, the meta_ledger_walker plan field, the label-dialect predicate, and the consumer-contract fixture amendment. Phase 259; facts preserved in .agent/staging/PHASE259_SEED.md.
The machine-author predicate consolidation, its machine author glossary term, and the doctrine-attribution.md edit. Moved to Phase 259 at iteration 6.
GH #431 and GH #432, filed separately 2026-09-04. GH #435 was filed on a false premise and is closed as an error of the plan author.
